question: A function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ is defined by $f(x)=x^2-4x+7$. Examine whether $f$ is one-one by finding two distinct elements having the same image.
explanation:
Choice of distinct inputs
Consider $x=1$ and $x=3$, where
$$1\ne3.$$

Evaluation of images
We have
$$f(1)=1^2-4(1)+7=1-4+7=4$$
and
$$f(3)=3^2-4(3)+7=9-12+7=4.$$
Hence,
$$f(1)=f(3).$$

Conclusion
Since two distinct elements of the domain have the same image, $f$ is not one-one.

options.A: $f$ is one-one because every real input has exactly one image
